name: GLASS Zero
source:
This game is a prequel to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431570/]"Glass"[/url], exploring the past and the formation of its universe.
It delves into the background before the main events of the original story, set in a multi-dimensional world, offering a deep understanding of the main characters' motivations and relationships.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046800/]Steam[/url]]
